faq: What does Doctor Color do in Match Masters?
It converts tiles to one color, creating mass cascade potential. Time it before a turn where you can chain matches and the cascades multiply your score.
How do I upgrade Doctor Color?
Doctor Color is a Diamond booster with 3 upgrade stages. Collect duplicate cards from events, spins and album rewards — Stage 3 is dramatically stronger than Stage 1.
Is Doctor Color one of the best boosters?
Player tier lists rank Doctor Color among the strongest Diamond-tier options, and its Special Edition version sits in A-tier. It is a top pick for score-focused play.
How can I get Doctor Color for free?
Daily gift links when the game publishes Diamond drops

faq: What does Foxy Roxy do in Match Masters?
It activates quickly and performs a reliable mid-game board reset — clearing trouble and giving you a fresh position to play from.
When should I use Foxy Roxy?
When you need a fast, dependable reset rather than maximum firepower. Player guides call it the best mid-tier Diamond pick before Special Edition boosters are available.

boosters.ability: A Legendary-tier booster — the rarest standard tier in the game. Its exact board effect is listed in the game's booster menu, which is always current.
boosters.best_modes: Tournaments and ranked matches, where the rewards justify spending your rarest boosters.
faq: What tier is Monkey Joo Joo?
Legendary — the top standard tier, above Diamond. It is not unlocked by rank.
How can I get Monkey Joo Joo for free?
Through in-game events and sticker album completion. Legendary boosters are never rank-gated — they come from events, Super Spins and seasonal challenges.
Is there a Monkey Joo Joo SE?
Player guides list Monkey Joo Joo among Special Edition boosters, so a seasonal SE variant appears in limited events.
how_to_get: Daily gift links if the game publishes a Legendary drop

faq: What does Billie Boom do in Match Masters?
It clears huge sections of the board, and its chain reactions generate extra moves — which is why player tier lists rate it S-tier and the best comeback booster in the game.
How can I get Billie Boom for free?
Through in-game events and Super Spins. Legendary boosters are not unlocked by rank — watch for events and seasonal challenges.
Which game mode is Billie Boom best in?
Score Rally and Party Rumble, where its chain reactions snowball. Save it for high-stakes matches.
